name: Message
description: A secure and auditable communication between a patient and their assigned doctor.

attributes.name: idOfUser
attributes.description: The user who sent this message. Only the sender or an admin/doctor involved in the conversation may access this message.

attributes.name: senderId
attributes.description: The ID of the user who sent the message (can be patient or doctor).

attributes.name: receiverId
attributes.description: The ID of the user who is the primary recipient of the message (can be patient or doctor).

attributes.name: conversationId
attributes.description: A unique identifier for the conversation thread.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the message was sent.

attributes.name: isRead
attributes.description: Indicates if the message has been read by the receiver.

attributes.name: readAt
attributes.description: The timestamp when the message was read.

attributes.name: messageType
attributes.description: The type of message (e.g., text, attachment).
